Class ConcurrencyConfig

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.config.ConcurrencyConfig
@Configuration public class ConcurrencyConfig extends Object
Makes the one ClientActivityDetector the application uses (issues #273, #284). Two settings, both from the environment: CLIENT_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SEC, how often an open tab sends a heartbeat (5), and CLIENT_TIMEOUT_MISSED_HEARTBEATS, how many intervals of silence make a tab count as gone (3). A tab is forgotten after the interval times the missed heartbeats, 15 seconds by default. A value that is not a whole number of at least 1 is replaced by the default, so a typo cannot stop the application from starting.
